title: C24106130096
paper_title: 多变量复杂环境下的磁芯损耗建模

strengths: starts with an interpretable shape baseline before feature fusion
reports several classification metrics and normalized confusion matrices
explicitly stress-tests a noisy setting and motivates richer representation from the observed degradation
risks: feature-wise min-max scaling for engineered features is computed on the complete matrix before train/validation split in the printed appendix, leaking validation extrema into training
random row split does not establish robustness to unseen material/frequency/Bm regimes even when validation accuracy is 100%
the paper calls range scaling “batch normalization”; this is conceptually different from neural-network batch normalization
noise robustness at one synthetic SNR is local perturbation evidence, not general out-of-domain robustness

route: log-linear LSE with NAdam vs closed-form/multiple linear regression
strengths: uses a clear hypothesis ladder from physics baseline to temperature correction to adaptive parameterization
compares numerical NAdam and linear-regression solutions for the log-linear form
printed appendix contains an actual neural parameterization for TLSEDSR rather than only a method name
risks: the stated evaluation uses an 80/20 random split within the same material/waveform/temperature support; R2≈1 and MRE≈0.12 are interpolation evidence, not unseen-temperature or unseen-material generalization
the adaptive coefficient network is much more flexible than fixed TLSE; fair model selection should use leave-temperature/leave-condition-out validation and complexity-controlled baselines
model selection and repeated correction design are developed on the same attachment, so final comparative claims need an untouched condition-level test

route: three-factor ANOVA with pairwise interaction terms
47-group sequential Mann-Whitney tournament to select low-loss condition
strengths: unlike S011, the paper explicitly writes and estimates interaction terms
Table 5.18 distinguishes significant waveform×material interaction from nonsignificant temperature interactions
uses a nonparametric comparison after acknowledging normality/homoscedasticity concerns
risks: the prose under Table 5.19 says the temperature F statistic is 3456.213, but that is the intercept row; the temperature row is 17.755

F statistics from separate one-factor models with different degrees of freedom/group structures are not effect sizes and should not be directly ranked as engineering influence; report partial eta-squared/omega-squared or adjusted contrasts
frequency and Bm are strong continuous covariates but are not adjusted in the factor-effect ranking, so cell composition can confound the conclusions
47 sequential Mann-Whitney tests are performed without visible family-wise/FDR correction
the incumbent-vs-next tournament is order-dependent and can miss co-optimal/nontransitive alternatives; compare all relevant cells with corrected post-hoc tests and confidence intervals

strengths: builds an explicit ablation ladder rather than presenting one opaque final model
printed appendix contains material and waveform embeddings and the WMTLMSEDSR code path
the paper reports that a pure deep model overfits, which is useful negative evidence for preserving physics structure
risks: all main model comparisons use random 80/20 row splits from the same attachment support; validation MRE≈0.02 does not prove cross-material/cross-condition extrapolation

the very large improvement from empirical model to flexible self-representation should be stress-tested with leave-material/temperature/waveform/frequency-region-out folds and a physics residual baseline
reported test-set predictions cannot be independently scored without target labels; submission output is not validation evidence

route: two objectives: minimize predicted loss and maximize f*Bm
GA and PSO on a six-variable mixed domain
strengths: states both engineering objectives and gives an explicit trade-off parameter scan
prints actual GA/PSO source code and result tables, allowing direct implementation audit
risks: paper constraint says f∈[50000,500000], while both printed GA and PSO code use lower bound 5000; the reported PSO point f=7862.85 is therefore infeasible under the paper model
temperature is discrete {25,50,70,90} and material/waveform are categorical integers, but the optimizers search continuous boxes; the printed path does not preserve the stated discrete feasible set
Eq. L=P_loss-lambda*energy exactly reproduces lambda 0.01/0.1/1 table rows, but lambda=10 and lambda=100 rows imply approximately 100 and 10 respectively, indicating row/label drift
the printed scripts hard-code Lambda=[0.01,0.1,1,10,100][4], i.e. lambda=100, so the complete lambda sweep table is not generated by one unchanged run
post-filtering only by historical output ranges does not repair decision-variable infeasibility or unsupported-domain extrapolation
weighted subtraction mixes objectives with different units/scales; lambda sensitivity should be defined after normalization or replaced by an explicit Pareto/epsilon-constraint route

verified_text_evidence.claim: Q1 feature ladder, noise stress test, printed SVM/normalization implementation
Q2 SE/LSE/TLSE/TLSEDSR progression and printed NAdam/deep self-representation code
Q3 explicit ANOVA interactions, one-factor F tables, sequential Mann-Whitney selection
Q4 ablation ladder, WMTLMSEDSR and printed embedding-based implementation
Q5 mathematical bounds, GA/PSO result tables and printed optimizer bounds/objective code

transfer_lessons: A strong paper can contain both good local ideas and invalid validation/optimization details; learn components, not whole-paper authority.
ANOVA F statistics establish signal relative to residual variance but are not directly comparable effect-size rankings across separate models; preserve effect-size semantics.
Many pairwise nonparametric tests need multiplicity control, and sequential winner tournaments need order-invariance checks.
For physics+deep hybrids, use an ablation ladder but rank models under deployment-relevant grouped/leave-condition-out folds.
Optimization code must import one machine-readable domain registry; a single 5000/50000 boundary drift can make the reported optimum invalid.
Mixed discrete/continuous variables must stay discrete/continuous in the optimizer or be repaired/decoded with explicit feasibility checks.
Every scalarized result table should be regenerated from the exact objective formula and reported P/energy values before publication.
